title: Validation errors return 422 instead of the spec's parenthetical 400
evidence: lib/books/router.ex:21,40 return json(conn, 422, %{errors: ...}); REQUIREMENTS.json R9 how_to_verify says 'rejected (400)'
suggestion: None required — 422 Unprocessable Entity is a correct and arguably more precise status for semantic validation failures; requirement (reject invalid input) is met.
